professionalSummary: Seasoned data scientist with six years of experience in production experimentation, specializing in causal inference techniques such as difference-in-differences and synthetic control.
Expertise in designing complex experiments—including geo and interference-aware designs—and in authoring rigorous analysis plans that guide product leadership decisions.
Proven track record of documenting design limitations and defining clear conclusion boundaries to ensure transparent and actionable insights.
experienceHighlights: Three years as a data scientist on a growth analytics platform, leading analysis of product experiments under a documented analysis standard.
Designed and executed two geo experiments for the pricing team, including power calculations and design documentation approved by the experimentation lead.
Applied causal inference methods to four experiments with compromised randomisation, producing analysis plans signed by the experimentation lead.
Authored design limitation and conclusion boundary sections for each experiment report, maintaining analysis notebook templates for the team.
Two years as a market research analyst, conducting survey analyses and building analytical rigor.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Analysis plan and report for a compromised-randomisation experiment, signed by the experimentation lead, with registry references.
Design document for a geo experiment, including power calculations and registry references.
skills: Causal inference (difference-in-differences, synthetic control), Geo experiment design, Switchback design, Interference-aware experiment design, Analysis plan authoring, Documentation of design limitations, Analysis standard compliance
